── Barracuda ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
No entry existed for "barracuda" - get_profile()/get_profile_key() silently fell
through to GENERIC_KVM_PROFILE (disk_bus="virtio", 512MB RAM cap). The on-disk
image (barracuda-fw8, id 97396424-2590-4473-b119-9763441a38b1) is IDE-formatted,
so virtio meant the guest never saw a bootable disk; separately, the 512MB cap is
under Barracuda CloudGen NGFW's real footprint - live-observed the node sitting at
563/512 MB (110% of cap) under the hypervisor's soft RAM ceiling. Same class of gap
already fixed once for "esxi" above (2026-07-18) and "isrv"/"titanium" before that.

reasons.nic:
NIC e1000 -> virtio-net-pci (NPX-824, 2026-09-05). Evidence, not a guess: EVE-NG
PRO v7's own production template for this exact image says `qemu_nic:
virtio-net-pci` (docs/reference/eveng-implementation/raw/templates/barracuda.yml), so a
shipping product has run this guest on virtio for years - the driver is in the
image. e1000 is emulated packet-by-packet in userspace and can never use the
kernel fast path; virtio can (vhost-net, NPX-823). Live-booted on netplex before
this landed - run recorded in docs/status/PLATFORM-AUDIT.md NPX-824.
reasons.console:
console corrected 2026-07-23 from a live cross-reference against EVE-NG PRO v7's own
production template for this exact image (root@<eveng-box>:/opt/unetlab/html/
templates/intel/barracuda.yml): `qemu_options: -machine type=pc,accel=kvm -vga std
-usbdevice tablet -boot order=dc` - real VGA + pointer hardware, the same signal
that root-caused cumulus-vx's silent zero-console-output bug (NPX-297). NOT
live-boot-verified here (unlike cumulus-vx's real `virsh screenshot` proof) -
applied from cross-reference evidence alone, disclosed per rule #31.
